_comment: I2 (docs/BUILD-LOOP.md Step 2 plan, approved 2026-09-08), UPGRADED to
reachability the same day (Mark's review): every export in public/ and
src/ that is not reachable from a PRODUCT entry point (wrangler.jsonc's
"main", or the module scripts in public/index.html and public/city.html)
must be removed, wired to something product-reachable, or named here with
a written reason -- a sentence, not the word 'intentional'. Checked by
test/deadExports.test.ts.
WHY REACHABILITY, NOT IMPORT COUNTING. 'does anything import this' and
'is this reachable from what a visitor or the Worker actually runs' are
different questions and they can disagree: roadkit.js's junction and
roundabout genuinely ARE imported -- by public/roadkit-street-demo.js, a
DEMO page nothing else imports. An export imported only by a module
nothing reaches is still dead. The first version of this gate (import-
counting only) could not see that and reported roadkit's junction
builders as confirming a claim that they were fully uncalled, when the
true, more precise finding is 'demo-only' -- a real, different state from
either 'called' or 'fully dead'. Entries below carry one of three states
in their own seeded text: demo-only (has a caller, but only from a demo
page), test-only (has a caller, but only from test/), or unreachable
(no caller of any kind).
PLATFORM BINDINGS ARE NOT JS IMPORTS. wrangler.jsonc's durable_objects
class_name bindings and its "main" entry point are read directly by the
Cloudflare platform, never through a JS import -- SpendCounterDO (the
bound spend-cap Durable Object) and src/index.ts's own default export
are seeded as product-reachable by platformReachableExports precisely so
neither can land in this file. test/deadExports.test.ts also runs an
independent guard that fails outright if any wrangler.jsonc-declared name
ever appears here, regardless of what the reachability graph concludes.
THIS FILE IS SEEDED, NOT EARNED. Every entry was written by a one-time,
uncommitted script from the gate's own first reachability-aware run over
the committed tree on 2026-09-08 -- it makes the gate start green by
construction, not because each entry has been individually reviewed. A
large fraction of the 'unreachable' entries are the SAME shape: functions
exported individually but reached in the live system only through a
dispatch table defined in the SAME file (buildings.js's bldVilla/
bldTerrace/... reached via building(), never imported by name from
anywhere else; props.js's model functions reached the same way through
MODELS/getModel) -- architecturally wired, just not through a cross-file
import this gate's simple regex-based forward graph can see, by design
(reusing the existing parser rather than building full call-graph
analysis of dynamic dispatch).
This gate's real value starts the first time it catches an export ADDED
after 2026-09-08 with no product-reachable caller and no entry here -- not
from this seed list being individually correct today.
MERGED, 2026-09-11, b1-land -> codex-lane: this file is the union of two
INDEPENDENTLY SEEDED allowlists (codex-lane, 2026-09-08; b1-land, RUN2-CLI-
2026-09-09) -- docs/specs/COMPLETION-PLAN.md PART 3 C2 records b1-land's
own seeding was deliberately fresh, not copied from codex-lane. 2745 of
2771 keys existed on both sides with DIFFERENT placeholder text; b1-land's
wording was kept on those (it names the mechanism and a real run date,
closer to what C2 itself asks for), per Mark's own direct decision during
the 2026-09-11 merge, not a reviewed judgement -- NEITHER side's text for
these entries has been individually reviewed. 7 keys existed only on
codex-lane, 19 only on b1-land; both sets' code was verified present in
the merged tree before this file was written (see
docs/audits/MERGE-b1-land-into-codex-lane-2026-09-11.md).
